verdict.rationale: Anrok's API offers read endpoints that could be used to pull data out programmatically as JSON over a REST API: listing and retrieving customers, fetching filings, and syncing transactions with a billing system. Nothing documents a bulk 'export all data' feature, an open-format export, or an offboarding path. missing for 10: documented full-account export, open file formats (e.g. CSV) for transactions, certificates and registrations, explicit data-portability or offboarding guidance, independent corroboration.
